custom_url_category_id.description: An internal index number used by the system to identify the custom category.

custom_url_info.description: A container object that details the actual URLs and/or system categories included in this custom category.

category_list_info.description: Defines the system-defined URL categories that are included in this custom category.

category_list.description: An array of system category IDs to be included. This allows a custom category to be a combination of specific URLs and pre-defined categories.

category_list_info.title: CategoryListInfo

type.description: The type of information contained in the list (e.g., list_of_urls, list_of_categories).

url_list_info.description: Defines the specific URLs (or URL patterns) that are explicitly included in this custom category.

url_list.description: AAn array of URLs, domains, or IP addresses that belong to this custom category.

url_list_info.title: UrlListInfo

custom_url_info.title: CustomUrlInfo

description.description: A description or explanation of what this category contains. Maximum length of 256 characters.

id.description: The unique system identifier for this specific Custom URL Category resource.

name.description: A unique, user-friendly name for the Custom URL Category. Required field. Maximum length of 128 characters.

tags.description: An array (list) of key-value tags or labels for organizational purposes. Allows a maximum of 10 unique tags.

url_category_type.description: Specifies whether the category is system-defined or user-created.
